---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- read_rds("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month)
```

```{r}
summary(mallards$speed)
```

```{r}
mallards <- mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30)

ggplot(mallards, aes(x = speed, y = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  labs(x = "Speed (m/s)", y = "Month")
```
